affinity.notes: Pervasive lava-orange channels and embers read unmistakably as fire affinity.

anatomy.notes: Horns, wings, armored torso, and seated limbs form a coherent demonic figure.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "fortified artillery tank" does not semantically communicate Corona-Throne Legion Sovereign (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: The static throne presentation offers no cleanly readable attack windup or exposed weak point.

finish.notes: Surface detail and molten accents are consistently rendered to a high finish.

framing.notes: The dark body merges into the throne and dense machinery, weakening combat silhouette clarity.

identity.notes: Blind perception "armored infernal demon lord" semantically identifies demons/demon-prince.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "boss" is accepted for intended T5 under the documented v2 normalization.
